title: Search Trigger Policy — need_search Detector Rules
description: Defines when Codex Factory should trigger a search (need_search=true) vs when it should not (need_search=false). Search is NOT a one-time pre-task action; it can be triggered at any phase.

frameworkOrLibraryReference.description: Task references a framework, library, API, CLI tool, or config option

versionOrLatestPattern.description: Task involves specific version, latest syntax, or release notes

externalPlatformReference.description: Task involves external platforms: WeChat, payment, maps, cloud, object storage

buildOrTestFailure.description: Build/test/lint failure possibly from external dependency or version incompatibility

newDependencyIntroduction.description: Codex is about to introduce a new dependency

evidencePackInsufficient.description: Existing Evidence Pack lacks sufficient evidence for decision

securityOrCVE.description: Security vulnerability, CVE, or dependency upgrade needed

userRequestsLatest.description: User explicitly asks for latest information

lowConfidence.description: Agent has low confidence in external facts

nonTriggers.description: Conditions that do NOT trigger search

pureInternalLogic.description: Task involves only project-internal code logic

dataStructureModification.description: Clear data structure modification without external reference

styleOnlyChange.description: Pure style/format change without new library

evidencePackSufficient.description: Existing Evidence Pack provides sufficient evidence

modeSelectionRule.description: live_api only if API key present AND human approved; otherwise fallback to dry_run

stopCondition.description: Stop when: evidence sufficient, max rounds reached, or human escalation
